event.title: Bitcoin Up or Down - October 8, 3:40PM-3:45PM ET
event.description:
This market will resolve to "Up" if the time-weighted average price (TWAP) of Bitcoin, generated by Chainlink, of the time range specified in the title is greater than or equal to the price at the beginning of that range. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Down".
The resolution source for this market is information from Chainlink, specifically the BTC/USD TWAP data stream available at https://data.chain.link/streams/btc-usd-twap-60s-streams.
Please note that this market is about the price according to the TWAP Chainlink data stream for the asset pair BTC/USD, not according to any other sources or spot markets.

This market will resolve to "Up" if the time-weighted average price (TWAP) of Bitcoin, generated by Chainlink, of the time range specified in the title is greater than or equal to the price at the beginning of that range. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Down".
The resolution source for this market is information from Chainlink, specifically the BTC/USD TWAP data stream available at https://data.chain.link/streams/btc-usd-twap-60s-streams.
Please note that this market is about the price according to the TWAP Chainlink data stream for the asset pair BTC/USD, not according to any other sources or spot markets.

event.question: Game Spread: Laslo Djere (-3.5) vs Hynek Barton (+3.5)
event.description:
This market will resolve to "Laslo Djere" if Laslo Djere wins 3.5 or more total games than Hynek Barton in the upcoming tennis match, scheduled for October 9, 2026 at 10:00AM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Hynek Barton".
Games won will be counted across all sets played in the match. A set decided by a tiebreak will count as one game for the winner of that tiebreak, and a match tiebreak played in place of a final set will also count as one game for its winner.
If the match is canceled (not played at all), or is delayed beyond 14 days from the scheduled date without completion at 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50.
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the match ends at a point where Laslo Djere could no longer have finished 3.5 or more games ahead even by winning every remaining game, this market will resolve to "Hynek Barton".
If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.
The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

event_message.title: Villena: Laslo Djere vs Hynek Barton
event_message.description:
This market refers to the tennis match between Laslo Djere and Hynek Barton in the Villena, originally scheduled for October 9, 2026 at 10:00AM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Laslo Djere' if Laslo Djere advances against Hynek Barton.

This market will resolve to 'Hynek Barton' if Hynek Barton advances against Laslo Djere.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by October 23, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one player advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the player who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (player withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the ATP Tour. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
